dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003

binders: A natural number m, universally quantified, specifying the common matrix and vector dimension.
Two arbitrary sequences P and E, where for every k in Nat, P_k and E_k are real m-by-m matrices indexed by Fin(m) x Fin(m).
An arbitrary real vector b indexed by Fin(m).
conclusions: For the recursively defined vectors u, v, w, and z, the exact coordinate identity z_r(i)=u_r(i)+t v_r(i)+t^2 w_r(i) holds.
mathematical_definitions: For an m-by-n real matrix A and vector x in R^n, define (Ax)(i)=sum over j in Fin(n) of A(i,j)x(j).
Define v_0=0 and v_{k+1}=P_k v_k+E_k u_k.
Define w_0=0 and w_{k+1}=P_k w_k+E_k v_k+t(E_k w_k). This sequence depends on t.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every natural dimension m, every real t, arbitrary time-indexed real m-by-m matrices P_k and E_k, every initial vector b, every natural time r, and every coordinate i, let z evolve by z_0=b and z_{k+1}=(P_k+tE_k)z_k. Let u, v, and w evolve respectively by u_0=b, u_{k+1}=P_k u_k; v_0=0, v_{k+1}=P_k v_k+E_k u_k; and w_0=0, w_{k+1}=P_k w_k+E_k v_k+tE_k w_k. Then exactly, coordinate by coordinate, z_r=u_r+t v_r+t^2 w_r.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The dimension m is unrestricted and may be zero. If m=0, Fin(m) has no coordinate i, so the universally quantified proposition is vacuous.
There are no hypotheses on t, b, P_k, or E_k: no positivity, boundedness, invertibility, constancy, or commutativity assumptions are encoded.
The assertion is an exact identity in real arithmetic, not an approximation, asymptotic statement, floating-point error claim, or norm bound.

The sequence w depends on t through the term tE_k w_k. Thus t^2 w_r is an exact remainder containing all dependence beyond the displayed constant and linear terms; the proposition does not assert that w is a t-independent second-order coefficient.
No norms, inequalities, conjunctions, existential witnesses, or claims about the size or regularity of u, v, w, or z are present.

At r=0 the equality reduces to b(i)=b(i)+t*0+t^2*0. For positive r, only matrix indices below r affect the recursively defined values, although P and E are supplied as total sequences on all natural indices.
